title: Fantastic Bike Tour with Angie in Barcelona
text:
I had the pleasure of joining a 3-hour bike tour of Barcelona today with Angie as our guide. It was an amazing experience! Angie was knowledgeable, friendly, and made the tour both informative and enjoyable. We visited beautiful spots around the city, and biking through the streets allowed me to see Barcelona from a different perspective. I highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to explore the city in a fun and active way. Thank you, Angie, for such a memorable experience!

title: Angie is the best!
text: Angie was the best! super friendly and knowledgeable, we had a great time. there’s plenty of breaks to drink some water (she led us to a store before the bikes to grab water if we didn’t pack any) and take pictures. She was patient and answered every question enthusiastically. I can’t say enough nice things 10/10 recommend.
